Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 11 June 2025(Wednesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bulacan, Quezon, Batangas, Cavite, Metro Manila, Nueva Ecija, Rizal and Laguna within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol) and Tarlac(San Jose, Capas, Mayantoc, San Clemente, Bamban) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

[1:41PM] #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth flow is observed underneath the Iyana Dopemu bridge heading towards Ile-zik, with Ile-zik connecting to Sule junction also experiencing perfect traffic movement. There is a minor hold-up at Ile-zik due to traffic alternation.

 The route from Ile-zik towards Ajayi farm is currently clear, however, the flow of traffic becomes slow after Ajayi farm heading towards National. 

Commuters can expect good vehicular movement from Airport bus stop towards the Bolade intersection, though slight delays may occur at traffic light-controlled points. The return journey is very calm and free of any obstructions, with officers present and managing the traffic effectively.

data.text:
It’s ironic how some Kakampinks are now asking Leni Robredo to intercede and urge her supporters to flock to EDSA in protest of the Senate’s action on VP Sara’s impeachment.

But why would Leni support your cause when your group has devolved into little more than an anti-Duterte, Marcos-leaning movement that’s increasingly less pro-Leni? You now cozy up to the very name—Marcos—that she has long stood against. The Marcoses are the sworn enemies of the Yellow-Pink movement, and BBM is the name you once vowed, “Never again.” It’s a name you can’t say without also uttering, “anak ng diktador at magnanakaw.”
